summary: SiteRecruitmentResources is responsible for managing recruitment-related data, including resource IDs and status of recruitment (open or closed) with interaction modal popups designed for engagement.
purpose: To manage recruitment resources through a structured form view and provide users with the ability to add, edit, or delete recruitment information along with modality for handling resources.

workflows.name: Manage Recruitment Resources
steps: Data bind form view to resources and allows edits.
Use modal popup for resource details.

business_rules: Auto-generated fields should be handled with care.
